book.name: Jon
book.title: Yesu Kalisi-te banye nivasa lohvu Jon kaavu

content: Yesu vakaas having Nikotemus
+ o 3:1 Jon 7:50; 19:39*De hil Yuda-te yêêv ti nando, haale nambe Nikotemus, yi Palisai ti,

+ o 3:2 Mat 22:16; Jon 9:16*ond omaahôô-ju la vu Yesu hôôk busin-ambe nêêl vu nambe, “Kaputung, hey alak ganim nambe hong kaputung sen Anutu wiing hong laam-ato. In nambe Anutu me-mando gaving omaaho ti le, ond me-lohvu nambe biing taahu taahu osin niwêêk naambe sen onawiing-anja le.”
+ o 3:3 Mat 18:3; 1Pi 1:23*Tombe Yesu nêêl laah vu yi nambe, “Sa naanêêl keen lôôt vu hong naambe omaaho ti me-naatu omaaho moos ti jesin naah e ond me-le mando gaving Anutu-te hil e.”
Le Nikotemus nêêl nambe, “Le omaaho ti tata lak le naatu omaaho moos ti naah naambe tana? Mak lohvu nambe dukanaah tangganaan baambu be tangganaan gako yi jesin naah mava?”

+ o 3:5 Esi 36:25-27; Tit 3:5*Tombe Yesu vu vêêl lava laah nambe, “Sa naanêêl keen lôôt vu hong naambe bel osin Vavi Vaambuung-ame gako omaahonôôn-ambe daatu moos e, ond sil-ame le mando gaving Anutu-te hil e.
+ o 3:6 Saam 51:5; Jon 1:13*Va sen naavi hako ond yoo naavi, tonde va sen Vavi Vaambuung hako ond manyinju Vavi Vaambuung nando having,
om game gambindis in saanêêl vu hong nambe ham naatu moos-ato le.

+ o 3:8 Ekl 11:5*De vavi yoo valu-have va be la osin ka, tombe ohangoyin daandun, lemu danggakook sen laam-ato de valup-ambe la tana ond ondoosin. De hil pin sen latu moos lak Vavi Vaambuung-ato ond yik nambêênja.”
Tombe Nikotemus nêêl laah vu nambe, “Vakasin-anja le nôôn jak naambe vaati?”
Tombe Yesu nêêl nambe, “Islel-ate kaputung ti hong, le ondoosin vaa-jo?
+ o 3:11 Jon 3:32; 8:26*Sa naanêêl keen lôôt vu hong naambe hey naanêêl va sen hey alak nii-to, de va sen hey aahe lung laa-to ond hey naanêêl langaah, lemu ham-ame awii-having heyate vakasin e.
+ o 3:12 Luk 22:67*De saanêêl vakasin ak va vu voon-anjo le ham-ame awii-having e, om naambe sa naanêêl vakasin ak va baandoni ond ham e ambiing gaving naambe vaati?
+ o 3:13 Pro 30:4; Lom 10:6*De omaaho ti me-lak-ambe la baandoni de lom e, yik Omaahonôôn Noow oo timu vu baandoni be lukalaam voon.
+ o 3:14 Nam 21:9; Jon 8:28; 12:32*Tonde vu bôôy ond Mose hasi nyêêy kanu ti lakala haah vu taaku lumbalaamb, tombe yik hil e gasi Omaahonôôn Noow jakana naambêênju,
+ o 3:15 Jon 20:31*in nambe hil pin sen londpayo na timu vu yii-to ond sil mando metumin danggata.

+ o 3:16 Lom 5:8; 8:32; 1Jon 4:9-10; Jon 3:36; 10:28*“In Anutu yoo ka pasiv lôôt in hil pin vu voon, om wiing Noow yoo nôôn timu laam in nambe hil pin sen londpayo na timu vu yii-to me-lana mend nama le, malis, sil oo mando metumin danggata.
+ o 3:17 Luk 19:10; Jon 5:22; 12:47; Sin 17:31*In Anutu me-wiing Noow laam voon in nambe bu nyevahaan dôôk omaahonôôn-ate nipaya le, malis, wiing yi laam in nambe dôôvu sil.

+ o 3:18 Jon 3:36; 5:24*Om hil sen londpayo la timu vu yii-to ond silanêênd vakasin ma, de hil sen londpayo me-la timu vu yii-to ond me-lalohvu nambe lambiing vakasin e, le daatovu nyevahaan-ambe lana mend nama, in londpayo me-la timu vu Anutu Noow nôôn timuu-ju le.
+ o 3:19 Jon 1:5,9; 8:12*De lana mend namaa-ju dangga nambe melangaah laam voon lung la, lemu hil lawiingin mekanu, de me-lawiingin melangaah e, in silate kul anipaya.
+ o 3:20 Ep 5:11-13*Tonde hil pin sen dawiing va nipayaa-to ond nind baya lôôt in melangaah, de me-dala vu le, in nambe le taato va sen dawiing-ato langaah.
Lemu hil sen yoo dawiing va nivalok-ato ond dalaam vu melangaah in nambe taato langaah naambe dawiing kul lak Anutu-te niwêêk.”
Jon tatekin Yesu-te dangga
+ o 3:22 Jon 4:1-2*Lung laa tonde Yesu having yite maanggêêm-aso be lala taaku Yudia, tombe sil dandôô-ju le mem mondalipis hil nandôô-ju.
Tonde Jon oo monalipis hil vu Inon ngaaho vu Selim, in taakuu-ju bel ngeeyaata neep, om hil dala vu be nalipis sil,
+ o 3:24 Mat 4:12*in Helot-ame hatung Jon hôôk kalaambus e de yoo naahen.
Tonde Jon-ate maanggêêm-aso de Yuda ti be sil dakaas ak va sen hil dalipis in nambe Anutu ji sil anivasaa-to.

+ o 3:26 Jon 1:26-34*Om Jon-ate maanggêêm-aso lalaah lato vu Jon-ambe lanêêl vu nambe, “Kaputung, omaaho sen bôôy nando having hong vu bel Yoladan vaalung-anjuuto de ganêêl vakasin langaah ak yii-to, ond omaahôô-ju nalipis hil tombe hil pin dala vu yi.”
+ o 3:27 Jon 19:11; 1Ko 4:7; Hiblu 5:4*Tombe Jon nêêl laah vu sil nambe, “Naambe Anutu baandoni me-bu vati vu omaaho ti le, ond me-lohvu nambe gako le.

+ o 3:28 Jon 1:20,23; Mat 11:10*De ham oo hango vakasin sen saanêêl lung la bôôy-ato nambe, ‘Same omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt in nambe dôôvu yiiy-ato le, nganjo Anutu yoo wiing sa laam munggin vu yi.’

+ o 3:29 Mat 9:15*Omaaho ti nambe gako vêêh moos ond vêêh-anju tu moow-anju yoo timu vane, de yite omaaho ango sen nando having yi be nango lavaa-to ond yoo le naapêêlis lôôt, om nambêênja gêên sa longgpayo yoo nivasa lôôt in hil ngeeyaata dala vu Yesu,
tombe haale le naatu bopaata jak, de sa haalengg e naatu pasiv.”

+ o 3:31 Jon 8:23; 1Jon 4:5*Omaaho sen laam vu baandonii-to ond savok va pin, de omaaho sen yite danggakook neep vu voon ond yi vu voon, om nanêêl vakasin ak va voon-ate. Keen, omaaho sen laam vu baandonii-to ond savok va pin la,
+ o 3:32 Jon 3:11*de va sen yi me lak osin va sen hango lung laa-to ond yoo nanêêl langaah, lemu omaahonôôn-ame lawii-having yite vakasin e.
Tonde hil sen lawii-having yite vakasin-ato ond laliinggis nambe Anutu yi omaaho vakasin keen.
+ o 3:34 Jon 1:32; Sin 10:38*In omaaho sen Anutu wiing laam-ato ond nanêêl Anutu-te vakasin, in Anutu vu Vavi Vaambuung osin doos-ambe hôôvu yi.
+ o 3:35 Mat 11:27; Jon 5:20; 10:17*De Mangganaan oo ahe having Noow, tombe vu va pin lukala Noow nama.

+ o 3:36 Jon 3:16-18; 1Jon 5:12; Luk 3:7*Om hil sen londpayo na timu vu Anutu Noow-ato ond sil e mando metumin danggata, de hil sen me-lambiing gaving Anutu Noow lava le ond sil-ame le mando metumin e, malis, Anutu ahekalin vu sil-ambe neep.
